asst_vwap.label: 5-minute VWAP estimate
asst_vwap.source_note: Yahoo Finance unadjusted 5-minute HLC3 weighted by bar volume; an estimate, not reported trade VWAP or company issuance proceeds. Only retrieved regular-session bars are included, with no claim of full SIP coverage. Bars exclude the bar beginning at the close; closing-auction coverage follows the source's timestamps, and volume may differ from end-of-day daily bars.
asst_vwap.fallback_reason: Missing or nonfinite price/volume in an eligible minute.

other_disclosures_reviewed.basis: SATA $100 minimum issuance price and Business Day amendment; 13% rate retained for November. No change to the October 9 balances or current 13% rate.

rounding: Filing quantities and dollar totals are preserved as disclosed. Strive dashboard has fractional BTC; the existing panel prices the filed BTC quantity at the issuer dashboard average cost. No report formula changed.
